title: AbsoluteSolverMz
description: Tema creado por Mezsa para Visual Studio Code, con paleta púrpura, snippets y sugerencias en línea (Tab).

title: Ayu Dark EMC
description: A warm, low-glare Ayu dark theme with an OKLCH-balanced palette, ported from the ayu-dark-emc Emacs theme.

title: PKL Viewer & Pickle Viewer
description: PKL viewer and pickle viewer for Python .pkl, .pickle and .p files that opens them without Python and never runs their code, with a tree, NumPy arrays, pandas tables, opcodes and a safety check.

title: Project Manager (Maotou)
description: Easily switch between projects. Fork of Project Manager by Alessandro Fragnani, with drag and drop to assign tags

title: Avro Viewer, Arrow Viewer & Feather Viewer
description: Avro viewer, Arrow viewer and Feather viewer that opens .avro, .arrow, .feather and .ipc files as a fast paged table with schema, column stats, search and CSV or JSON export. No Python needed.

title: 3D Model Viewer (GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, PLY)
description: 3D model viewer for GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, PLY and 3MF files in VS Code, with wireframe, glTF animations, a scene tree, model stats, point-to-point measuring and PNG screenshots, all offline.

title: Graphviz Preview & DOT Viewer
description: Graphviz preview for .dot and .gv files and dot blocks in Markdown, with live updates, error lines, pan, zoom and SVG or PNG export. Offline.

title: TIFF Viewer (16-bit, Float, GeoTIFF)
description: Open TIFF and GeoTIFF files in VS Code. Multi-page stacks, 16-bit and float data with auto contrast, pixel values, tags and PNG export. Offline.

title: DICOM Viewer & NIfTI Viewer for CT and MRI
description: DICOM viewer and NIfTI viewer for CT and MRI scans in VS Code. Opens .dcm files, DICOM folders, .nii and .nii.gz with window presets, axial, coronal and sagittal views, HU under the cursor and a searchable tag table.
